# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

 

## Tricia Fitzgerald's Story

Meet the Fitzgerald family: Mom, dad, and 6 kids. Life with chronic conditions is not simple, but
with CVS Health by their side, managing chronic conditions becomes a little… simpler.

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

 

## Tricia Fitzgerald's Story

Meet the Fitzgerald family: Mom, dad, and 6 kids. Life with chronic conditions is not simple, but
with CVS Health by their side, managing chronic conditions becomes a little… simpler.

[Learn more][121]

## Happening at CVS Health®

### Here for women

Through our services, products, policies and partnerships, we're supporting the mental and physical
well-being of all women.

[Learn more about women's health][122]

## Investing in America’s health

### Creating a sustainable future

We’re helping shape a better world today, and for generations to come, through our impact
priorities.

[Understand our impact][123]

## Empowering future growth

### Living our purpose

We couldn’t be prouder of our colleagues that have made us the leading health care company.

[Learn more about our people ][124]

### Bring your heart to CVS Health

We are committed to building a workplace where every person is welcome, valued and can fulfill their
potential. Join us! 

[Explore career opportunities][125]

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]
[

### Think Beyond: Latest Evidence for Effective Therapies in CKD

Join experts at the Global Renal Nutrition Webinar on June 16, 2026. Explore ERA 2026 insights,
protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.
[Global Kidney Nutrition Webinar Key Visual]
][110]

At Fresenius Kabi, colleagues worldwide share personal stories for International Women’s Day,
honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.

[

### Fresenius Kabi recognized as a Top Employer in 13 countries

countries and additionally two regions.
[Image showing the top employer 2026 seals of the 13 countries and 2 regions.]
][112]

### Four Colleagues, Four Scientific Journeys: Voices of Women in Science

Female scientists from Biopharma, MedTech, Nutrition and Pharma share their stories and advice,
showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.

Unseen heroes ensure patient safety through precision, care, and smart tech at Fresenius Kabi.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems. 

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

[Man holding a surfing board smiling with a ocean in the background.]

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission across oncology, worldwide.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types

  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals

  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

How do I cancel my subscription?

#### Insight Development

#### Actionable Deliverables

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

next”.

to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions

uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

Our Thematic & Disruption Research identifies the structural shifts, emerging technologies, new
business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

Deep dives on cross-cutting themes such as sustainability, digital transformation, AI, automation,
circular economy and new revenue models. We connect these themes back to specific industry and
segment opportunities.

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is
resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

focus, market entry, pricing, partnership strategy and capital allocation grounded in evidence.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder

# Dependable medical supply support for Indian health organizations.

Tribal Innovations is a Native-owned medical-supply distributor helping Indian Health Service
facilities, tribal healthcare programs, and urban Indian health organizations access the products
they need with responsive, relationship-first service.

[Request a quote][8][View product categories][9]

Why Tribal Innovations

## Native ownership, workflow capability, and fulfillment depth — together

Tribal Innovations combines Native-owned positioning with the operational capability and supply
depth to actually deliver — making us a more credible partner for Indian health organizations.

### Native-owned and procurement-aligned

Built to serve Indian Health Service facilities, tribally operated healthcare programs, and urban
Indian health organizations through a Native-owned business model.

### Workflow capability that supports execution

Tribal’s model is designed to help manage invoicing, account coordination, and the practical steps
required to move orders forward.

### Supply depth through a national partner

The company’s operating model combines community alignment with broader fulfillment infrastructure,
helping reduce the gap between access and reliable delivery.

Who We Serve

## Supporting the organizations at the heart of Indian health procurement

### Indian Health Service facilities

Reliable medical-supply support for Indian health operations.

### Tribally operated healthcare programs

Responsive service built for the way tribal healthcare programs work.

### Urban Indian health organizations

Dependable product access through a Native-owned partner.

[Cardinal Health — authorized distributor partner of Tribal Innovations]

Supply Partnership

## Authorized distributor partner of Cardinal Health

A recurring challenge in this market is vendors who win contracts but lack the supply depth to
fulfill reliably. Tribal Innovations addresses this directly: as an authorized Cardinal Health
distributor, customers get access to Cardinal's full product catalog and fulfillment infrastructure
— through a Native-owned partner.

Access to Cardinal Health's full medical-supply catalog

Reliable fulfillment through an established national supply network

Native-owned positioning without sacrificing product depth or reliability

What We Bring

## Built to deliver, not just to win the contract

Indian health procurement rewards vendors who show up reliably over time. Tribal Innovations is
built around the capabilities that make that possible.

Authorized Cardinal Health distributor — access to a broad national catalog, not a thin sourcing
list.

Native-owned positioning aligned with Indian health procurement pathways and preference programs.

Invoicing and billing support designed for Indian health settings, including coordination with
government payment workflows.

Direct, responsive account management — a real relationship, not a ticketing system.

A fulfillment model built for reliability, so the order that gets placed is the order that arrives.

Family Leadership

## Rooted in Jemez Pueblo, built for the long term

Tribal Innovations is led by a family with deep community roots in Jemez Pueblo and a clear
commitment to service, trust, and long-term follow-through.

[Meet the leadership team][10]
[Allen Gachupin]

### Allen Gachupin

President

Allen Gachupin founded Tribal Innovations and serves as President, leading the company with a
philosophy grounded in service, character, and accountability. A proud Jemez Pueblo tribal member
and U.S. Army veteran, he has dedicated his career to community leadership and building lasting
relationships.

[Kai Gachupin]

### Kai Gachupin

CEO

Kai Gachupin serves as CEO of Tribal Innovations, bringing more than two decades of experience
leading Native-owned businesses in energy, distribution, and government contracting. A proud Jemez
Pueblo tribal member, he leads company strategy and customer development with a long-term focus on
service and reliability.

Start the Relationship

## Ready to work together?

Reach out to Tribal Innovations to discuss your procurement environment, supply needs, or the kind
of relationship you want to build.

[Request a quote][11]
[Tribal Innovations logo]

Tribal Innovations LLC

Native-owned medical supply distribution

Tribal Innovations is building a grounded, relationship-first model for serving Indian health
procurement with dependable operational support, invoicing workflows, and fulfillment coordination.

[Exclusive Interview | China's First Class III Certificate! Innovative TCM Medical Device Pushes
Forward with FDA and CE International Certification][26]
Henan Lixinghe Medical Technology Co., Ltd. independently developed a TCM medical device—the
acupoint microwave stimulation device—which has passed the full-process review by the NMPA and
obtained the Class III Medical Device Registration Certificate, becoming China's first approved
Class III TCM medical device. Since 2021, Lixinghe has continuously built a patent matrix around its
acupoint microwave stimulation device, establishing a comprehensive portfolio that covers probes,
concentrators, complete system integration, and intelligent software. Starting in 2023, Lixinghe
initiated its overseas patent strategy, securing international patent families in the United States,
the European Union, Japan, and South Korea, and has commenced preparation for FDA and CE
certification applications.

[Jiangsu Aidea's Generic Darunavir Tablets Win NMPA Approval, Becoming First in China][28]
Jiangsu Aidea Pharmaceutical (688488.SH) has received drug registration approval from China's
National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) for its generic darunavir tablets, an HIV-1 protease
inhibitor prioritized in WHO guidelines. The company becomes the first in China to secure marketing
authorization for the generic darunavir tablet. Combined with the approval of its darunavir active
pharmaceutical ingredient in May 2026, the company has achieved vertical integration of raw
materials and finished products, ensuring supply chain stability and cost efficiency. This milestone
expands Jiangsu Aidea's antiretroviral drug pipeline, completing its comprehensive HIV combination
therapy offerings in the Chinese market and strengthening its competitive position in the
antiretroviral treatment sector.
2min read

[18 International Clinical Trials Across 16 Countries: MDCE CRO Delivers H1 2026 Global Expansion
Report][30]
In the first half of 2026, MDCE CRO released its half-year report on global expansion, highlighting
the advancement of 18 international multi-center clinical trials across 48 research centers in 16
countries. The company achieved landmark regulatory breakthroughs, securing FDA 510(k) clearance for
a neurointerventional device and entering the EU BtX pilot program. Additionally, MDCE CRO expanded
its global clinical delivery network, integrated AI tools to boost operational efficiency by over
68%, and grew its overseas talent pipeline by 21%. These milestones underscore the company's
transition to systematic, localized operations, providing robust support for Chinese innovative
medical devices to navigate complex global markets efficiently.
4min read
[Read More ][31]
Innovation
[Edge Medical-B (02675) Surges Over 13% in Early HK Trading as Three Self-Developed Surgical Robots
Win Australian Approval][32]
Shares of Edge Medical-B (02675) jumped more than 13% in early Hong Kong trading after the company
announced that three of its self-developed surgical robots—MP1000, SP1000, and MSP2000—have received
regulatory approval from Australia's Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA). This clearance marks
the formal entry of Edge Medical's multi-port, single-port, and integrated surgical robot platforms
into the Australian market, laying the groundwork for further expansion across the Asia-Pacific
region.

[July 23 Medical Morning News: Abbott's Tricuspid Valve Clip System Approved by NMPA, Beijing to
Implement Centralized Procurement for Five High-Value Consumables in August][34]
China's NMPA has approved Abbott's TriClip transcatheter tricuspid valve clip system, providing a
minimally invasive treatment for high-risk patients and completing its major global market access.
Meanwhile, Beijing will mandate public hospitals to use centrally procured high-value medical
consumables, including coronary stents and pacemakers, starting August 1 to significantly reduce
healthcare costs. Additionally, NeuroXess's brain-computer interface entered the NMPA's fast-track
review pathway; Jiangsu Canopus acquired a 90% stake in Wuhan Yijiabao for RMB 769.5 million; US
firm Xenter raised $58.25 million for its wireless medical platform; and Inner Mongolia issued new
measures to support the medical device industry.
4min read
[Read More ][35]
Innovation
[Ribo Life Science's FIC siRNA Anticoagulant Vortosiran Delivers Compelling Phase IIa Data, Poised
to Reshape $100B Antithrombotic Market][36]
Suzhou Ribo Life Science (06938.HK) has unveiled impressive Phase IIa clinical data for vortosiran
(RBD4059), the world's first-in-class small interfering RNA (siRNA) drug targeting coagulation
Factor XI (FXI), at the CPIC conference. The results demonstrated an average maximum FXI activity
reduction of 92% with effects sustained for months, supporting a potential
once-every-three-to-six-months dosing regimen. Notably, no treatment-related serious adverse events
or major bleeding events were reported, highlighting an excellent safety profile. As the first
clinical proof of concept for FXI siRNA in coronary artery disease patients, vortosiran addresses a
critical unmet need by offering effective antithrombotic protection while preserving hemostatic
function. With the global antithrombotic market projected to surpass $100 billion by 2031, Ribo Life
Science is strategically expanding its portfolio, having recently submitted Phase IIb trial
applications to the EMA for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolism,
alongside a Phase II application for another cardiovascular candidate RBD1119, solidifying its
leadership in the anticoagulation arena.

a neurointerventional device and entering the EU BtX pilot program. Additionally, MDCE CRO expanded
its global clinical delivery network, integrated AI tools to boost operational efficiency by over
68%, and grew its overseas talent pipeline by 21%. These milestones underscore the company's
transition to systematic, localized operations, providing robust support for Chinese innovative
medical devices to navigate complex global markets efficiently.
4min read
[Read More ][31]
Innovation
[Edge Medical-B (02675) Surges Over 13% in Early HK Trading as Three Self-Developed Surgical Robots
Win Australian Approval][32]
Shares of Edge Medical-B (02675) jumped more than 13% in early Hong Kong trading after the company
announced that three of its self-developed surgical robots—MP1000, SP1000, and MSP2000—have received
regulatory approval from Australia's Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA). This clearance marks
the formal entry of Edge Medical's multi-port, single-port, and integrated surgical robot platforms
into the Australian market, laying the groundwork for further expansion across the Asia-Pacific
region.
1min read
[Read More ][33]
Innovation
[July 23 Medical Morning News: Abbott's Tricuspid Valve Clip System Approved by NMPA, Beijing to
Implement Centralized Procurement for Five High-Value Consumables in August][34]
China's NMPA has approved Abbott's TriClip transcatheter tricuspid valve clip system, providing a
minimally invasive treatment for high-risk patients and completing its major global market access.
Meanwhile, Beijing will mandate public hospitals to use centrally procured high-value medical
consumables, including coronary stents and pacemakers, starting August 1 to significantly reduce
healthcare costs. Additionally, NeuroXess's brain-computer interface entered the NMPA's fast-track
review pathway; Jiangsu Canopus acquired a 90% stake in Wuhan Yijiabao for RMB 769.5 million; US
firm Xenter raised $58.25 million for its wireless medical platform; and Inner Mongolia issued new
measures to support the medical device industry.
4min read
[Read More ][35]
Innovation
[Ribo Life Science's FIC siRNA Anticoagulant Vortosiran Delivers Compelling Phase IIa Data, Poised
to Reshape $100B Antithrombotic Market][36]
Suzhou Ribo Life Science (06938.HK) has unveiled impressive Phase IIa clinical data for vortosiran
(RBD4059), the world's first-in-class small interfering RNA (siRNA) drug targeting coagulation
Factor XI (FXI), at the CPIC conference. The results demonstrated an average maximum FXI activity
reduction of 92% with effects sustained for months, supporting a potential
once-every-three-to-six-months dosing regimen. Notably, no treatment-related serious adverse events
or major bleeding events were reported, highlighting an excellent safety profile. As the first
clinical proof of concept for FXI siRNA in coronary artery disease patients, vortosiran addresses a
critical unmet need by offering effective antithrombotic protection while preserving hemostatic
function. With the global antithrombotic market projected to surpass $100 billion by 2031, Ribo Life
Science is strategically expanding its portfolio, having recently submitted Phase IIb trial
applications to the EMA for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolism,
alongside a Phase II application for another cardiovascular candidate RBD1119, solidifying its
leadership in the anticoagulation arena.
